summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing the third annual Future of Mining Challenge, a cleantech competition offering a US$1 million prize. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is involved. The filing is a routine corporate social responsibility initiative press release, not a reportable event triggering any investor action. No deal terms, financial metrics, or strategic corporate changes are present. Therefore, this filing falls outside the scope of special situations classifications.
